preconditions.description: The number of rows in the matrix is between 1 and 10^3, inclusive.
The number of columns in the matrix is between 1 and 10^3, inclusive.
Each cell in the matrix contains either 0 (landmine) or 1 (safe).

postconditions.description: The output is -1 if there is no safe path from the first column to the last column, otherwise it is the length of the shortest safe path.
